id: title:Gilbert09:retry the initial token mint on transient errors

review.posthog_relevance: Warehouse ingestion reliability and transient failure handling
review.reason: Adds a dedicated `mint_initial_token` wrapper and comments distinguishing its behavior from the existing `fetch` retry mechanism. This could prevent transient token-endpoint or 401 failures during warehouse data import from Taboola from causing a complete warehouse sync failure. It could also prevent unnecessary retry compounding.
